title: Create a stacked bar chart of number of passeng...

querychat_viz_widgets.ggsql:
SELECT
  class,
  sex,
  COUNT(*) AS passenger_count
FROM titanic
GROUP BY class, sex
VISUALISE class AS x, passenger_count AS y, sex AS fill
DRAW bar
SCALE DISCRETE x FROM ('First', 'Second', 'Third')
SCALE DISCRETE fill TO set2
LABEL x => 'Passenger class', y => 'Number of passengers', fill => 'Sex'
